title: thelypteris chrysodioides var. goyazensis
intro: Thelypteris chrysodioides var. goyazensis, commonly known as Goyaz fern, is a species of fern native to Brazil, belonging to the Thelypteris genus. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of various respiratory issues, inflammation, and pain relief. The therapeutic actions of Goyaz fern include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which may help to soothe and calm irritated mucous membranes. Bioactive constituents of Goyaz fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
